title: AlgebraDx: diagnostic classification models for skill-level diagnosis of algebra readiness
description:
AlgebraDx is a Python package that reports which specific algebra skills a student has and has not mastered, instead of one overall score. It fits diagnostic classification (cognitive diagnosis) models in the G-DINA family, including the LCDM, DINA, DINO, A-CDM, LLM and R-RUM as item-level special cases, to large-scale assessment data with rotated booklets, sampling weights and TIMSS jackknife or PISA Fay-BRR replicate weights.

It includes Q-matrix identifiability checks and empirical validation, item-level Wald tests, classification reliability, per-student mastery reports, a drafted twelve-skill attribute dictionary for algebra readiness, and a pipeline for the US TIMSS 2019/2023 grade-8 and PISA 2022 samples. Code MIT; documentation, Q-matrix and figures CC BY 4.0.
